sentences.en: And that's what they meant was that we're going to still try to reach these Trump voters with people who can relate to them and they can relate to.
sentences.zh: 他们的意思是，我们仍然会尝试通过那些能与特朗普选民产生共鸣，且选民也能与他们产生共鸣的人来接触这些选民。

sentences.en: But the question is, how do you even do that when so many of his supporters believe a lie?
sentences.zh: 但问题是，当他如此多的支持者相信一个谎言时，你该怎么做呢？

sentences.en: How is NBC?
sentences.zh: NBC该怎么做？

sentences.en: How is CNN?
sentences.zh: CNN该怎么做？

sentences.en: How are any of these TV networks, if they have decided that this is their mission,
sentences.zh: 如果这些电视网络已经决定这就是他们的使命，他们该怎么做？

sentences.en: how are they supposed to speak to people who believe something fundamentally untrue as a core part of their political identity?
sentences.zh: 他们该如何与那些将某种根本不真实的事情作为其政治身份核心部分的人对话？

sentences.en: — That's the catch-22.
sentences.zh: ——这就是那个第22条军规（进退两难的困境）。

sentences.en: How do you get that Trump movement person, who's also an insider, when the litmus test to be an insider in the Trump movement is to believe in the denialism or at least say you do?
sentences.zh: 当你成为特朗普运动内部人士的试金石是相信否认主义，或者至少声称你相信时，你如何去接触那个既是特朗普运动成员又是内部人士的人？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So that's a real journalistic problem.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个新闻业的现实问题。

sentences.en: And the thing that we haven't really touched here is, what are these networks doing day in and day out?
sentences.zh: 而我们在这里还没真正触及的一点是，这些电视网每天都在忙些什么？

sentences.en: They're not producing reported pieces, which I think it's a little easier.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有在制作深度报道，我觉得那相对容易些。

sentences.en: You just report the news.
sentences.zh: 你只需要报道新闻。

sentences.en: You go out into the world, talk to people, and then you present it to the world as a nuanced portrait of the country.
sentences.zh: 你深入现场，采访民众，然后将它作为对这个国家细致入微的刻画呈现给世界。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This thing is true.
sentences.zh: 这件事是真的。

sentences.en: This thing is false.
sentences.zh: 那件事是假的。

sentences.en: Again, in many cases, pretty straightforward.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，在很多情况下，这相当直截了当。

sentences.en: But their bread and butter is talking heads.
sentences.zh: 但他们的核心业务是“谈话头”（嘉宾访谈）。

sentences.en: It's live.
sentences.zh: 这是直播。

sentences.en: It's not edited.
sentences.zh: 没有经过剪辑。

sentences.en: It's not that much reported.
sentences.zh: 也没怎么经过深入采访。

sentences.en: I want the perspective from the Trump movement, journalistically, especially when it comes to denialism, but when it comes to some other major subjects in American life,
sentences.zh: 我想要从新闻角度了解特朗普运动的视角，特别是在涉及否认主义时，以及涉及美国生活中其他一些重大议题时，

sentences.en: you're walking into a place where they're going to say things that aren't true, that don't pass your journalistic standards, the most basic standards of journalism.
sentences.zh: 你正走进一个他们会说出不实之词的地方，这些言论不符合你的新闻标准，也就是新闻业最基本的标准。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you're saying if TV sticks with this model, the kind of low-cost, lots-of-talk approach to news, then they are going to have to solve the riddle of who to bring on,
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，如果电视媒体坚持这种模式，即那种低成本、大量谈话的新闻方式，那么他们就必须解开该请谁来上节目的难题，

sentences.en: who represents Trump's America, if they want that audience.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想要争取那部分观众，谁能代表特朗普的美国？

sentences.en: And now they've got this red line that they've established, that that person can't be someone who denies the 2020 election reality.
sentences.zh: 现在他们划定了一条红线，那就是那个人不能是否认2020年大选现实的人。

sentences.en: But like you just said, that's the litmus test for being in Trump's orbit.
sentences.zh: 但正如你刚才所说，那是进入特朗普圈子的试金石。

sentences.en: So this doesn't really look like a conundrum.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来并不像是一个难题。

sentences.en: This looks like a bit of a crisis for TV news because it may end up meaning that they can't hire that person that they need for this model,
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是电视新闻的一场危机，因为它最终可能意味着他们无法聘请到这种模式所需的人选，

sentences.en: which means that perhaps a network like NBC does need to wave goodbye to a big segment of these viewers and these eyeballs who support Trump.
sentences.zh: 这意味着像NBC这样的电视网，或许真的需要告别支持特朗普的那一大批观众和收视群体。

sentences.en: I mean, on the one hand, they are not ready to do that, and they would never concede that that's something they're ready to do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一方面，他们还没准备好这样做，而且他们永远不会承认自己准备好这样做。

sentences.en: The problem is, barring some kind of change in their news model, there's no solution to this.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，除非他们的新闻模式发生某种改变，否则这个问题无解。

sentences.en: But why bar changes to their news model, I guess, is the question.
sentences.zh: 但我猜问题在于，为什么要阻止他们的新闻模式发生改变呢？

sentences.en: Because over the years, it's gotten more and more expensive to produce news, the news that I'm talking about, like recorded packages and what we refer to as reporting.
sentences.zh: 因为多年来，制作新闻——也就是我所说的那些录制好的专题报道和我们称之为“报道”的内容——变得越来越昂贵。

sentences.en: Just go out and report the news.
sentences.zh: 去实地报道新闻就行了。

sentences.en: Don't gab about it.
sentences.zh: 别在那儿空谈。

sentences.en: Just what's going on, what's true, what's false.
sentences.zh: 只讲发生了什么，什么是真，什么是假。

sentences.en: That's actually very expensive in television, and they don't have the kind of money they used to have.
sentences.zh: 这在电视行业其实非常昂贵，而他们已经没有过去那种资金实力了。

sentences.en: So the Talking Heads is their way to do programming at a level where they can afford it.
sentences.zh: 所以“谈话头”节目成了他们维持节目制作水平且负担得起的方式。

sentences.en: They do some packages, 60 Minutes still does incredible work, NBC does packages, but the lion's share of what they do is what we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 他们确实做一些专题报道，《60分钟》依然在做令人难以置信的工作，NBC也做专题，但他们大部分的工作内容就是我们刚才谈到的那些。

sentences.en: And that's not going to change because the economics aren't there.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况不会改变，因为经济条件不允许。

sentences.en: So then a final option, of course, to borrow something Chris Licht said, is that a network like NBC perhaps doesn't put a jersey on,
sentences.zh: 所以最后一个选择，当然，借用克里斯·利希特（Chris Licht）的话说，就是像NBC这样的电视网或许不该“穿上球衣”（即选边站队），

sentences.en: but accepts the reality that a lot of the world sees them wearing a jersey.
sentences.zh: 但要接受这样一个现实：世界上很多人都认为他们已经选边站了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, nobody wants to be seen as wearing a jersey in our business.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我的意思是，在我们的行业里，没人愿意被视为选边站队。

sentences.en: No one wants to be wearing a jersey in our business.
sentences.zh: 在我们的行业里，没人想选边站队。

sentences.en: But maybe what they really have to accept is that we're just sticking to the true facts.
sentences.zh: 但也许他们真正必须接受的是，我们只是坚持事实真相。

sentences.en: And that may look like we're wearing a jersey, but we're not.
sentences.zh: 那看起来可能像是我们在选边站，但我们并没有。

sentences.en: And that may at times look like it's lining up more with the Democrats, but we're not.
sentences.zh: 那有时看起来可能更偏向民主党，但我们并没有。

sentences.en: If Trump is lying about a stolen election, that's not siding against him, that's siding for the truth, and that's what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普在谎称选举被窃取，那不是在反对他，而是在支持真相，这才是我们正在做的事。

sentences.en: Easier said than done, and I don't think any of these concepts are new.
sentences.zh: 说起来容易做起来难，而且我不认为这些概念是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: I think there have been attempts to do that, but it's the world they're in, and it's the only option they really have.
sentences.zh: 我认为曾有人尝试过这样做，但这就是他们所处的环境，也是他们真正拥有的唯一选择。

sentences.en: We're going to tell you the truth, even if it means that we're going to lose a big part of the country.
sentences.zh: 我们要告诉你们真相，即使这意味着我们将失去这个国家很大一部分受众。

sentences.en: Well, Jim, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，吉姆，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, thousands of protesters took to the streets of Tel Aviv and Jerusalem
sentences.zh: 周末期间，数千名抗议者走上特拉维夫和耶路撒冷的街头，

sentences.en: in some of the largest domestic demonstrations against the government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu since Israel invaded Gaza in the fall.
sentences.zh: 举行了自以色列秋季入侵加沙以来，针对本杰明·内塔尼亚胡总理政府规模最大的国内示威活动之一。

sentences.en: Some of the protesters called on Netanyahu to reach a ceasefire deal that would free the hostages taken by Hamas on October 7th.
sentences.zh: 一些抗议者呼吁内塔尼亚胡达成停火协议，以释放哈马斯在10月7日扣押的人质。

sentences.en: Others called for early elections that would remove Netanyahu from office.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则要求提前举行选举，将内塔尼亚胡赶下台。

sentences.en: During a news conference on Sunday, Netanyahu rejected calls for early elections, saying they would paralyze his government at a crucial moment in the war.
sentences.zh: 在周日的新闻发布会上，内塔尼亚胡拒绝了提前选举的呼吁，称这会在战争的关键时刻瘫痪他的政府。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko, Riki Neveski, and Alex Stern, with help from Stella Tan.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科（Rob Zipko）、里基·内韦斯基（Riki Neveski）和亚历克斯·斯特恩（Alex Stern）制作，斯特拉·谭（Stella Tan）提供协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Brendan Klinkenberg, with help from Rachel Quester and Paige Cowett.
sentences.zh: 由布伦丹·克林肯伯格（Brendan Klinkenberg）编辑，瑞秋·奎斯特（Rachel Quester）和佩奇·考特（Paige Cowett）提供协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marion Lozano, Dan Powell, and Rowan Emisto, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽昂·洛萨诺（Marion Lozano）、丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）和罗文·埃米斯托（Rowan Emisto）的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood）进行工程处理。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰兹伯格（Ben Landsberg）创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》（Metro）节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig）将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 所以拜托了。
